about_the_game:
In this card game, you are the creator of the cards.

Alegraz is a roguelite strategy card game where, in every run, you actively shape and define your cards yourself. There are no pre-built decks or memorized archetypes. Each run begins from scratch and evolves entirely through the decisions you make.

Every attempt presents different card options and enemies. Through mechanics such as upgrading, transforming, or sacrificing cards, you forge your own playstyle. Which cards grow stronger and which are discarded is completely up to you. In Alegraz, success does not come from drawing the right card — it comes from creating the right card.

Defeat is a natural part of progression. After each loss, permanent systems and new card options are unlocked, allowing you to begin the next run with greater strategic depth. The game is built around learning over time and refining your own unique approach.

Boss encounters emphasize planning and card design over fast reflexes. Victory is determined by how thoughtfully your card structures have been crafted long before the battle begins.

Alegraz offers replayability not through randomness alone, but through the card combinations created by the player. Every run represents a new build, a new mindset, and a new strategy.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760 (2048 MB) Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB Intel UHD Graphics 630
